disease-indications.literature: amyotrophic lateral sclerosis randomized survival function

8302340: A controlled human trial supports using ALS survival as a disease-level outcome.
25286015: A broader trial did not show a significant functional difference. Population and regimen matter.
28522181: A selected early ALS population showed a functional endpoint benefit.

proposals.goal: treat diagnosed ALS; look for disease-course outcomes

genes-targets.literature: amyotrophic lateral sclerosis EAAT2 glutamate transporter expression

7611729: Postmortem ALS tissue showed lower glial glutamate transporter protein. This is a group observation.
15635412: Preclinical induction of GLT1 expression increased glutamate transport. Upregulation is a research hypothesis.
25297012: The phase III test of the induction strategy did not improve ALS function or survival and had hepatobiliary toxicity.

pathways-processes.literature: amyotrophic lateral sclerosis glutamate transport astrocytes uptake

7611729: Glial transporter loss in ALS tissue motivates investigating glutamate clearance.
15635412: Increasing transporter expression enhanced glutamate uptake in models. This gives the proposed direction.
24771634: CSF concentrations reached the in-vitro-derived target in the ALS study. Site-specific engagement remains unknown.
25297012: Phase III clinical results did not validate the predicted benefit of increasing transporter activity.

proposals.goal: increase L-glutamate transport through expression of a participating transporter

safety-interactions-class.literature: CYP1A2 inhibition amyotrophic lateral sclerosis drug metabolism

9316860: Human microsomes showed CYP1A2-mediated metabolism. Inhibition could raise exposure to the index therapy.
37798423: Human clearance extrapolation also implicated extrahepatic metabolism. A single-enzyme distance cannot quantify an interaction.

label.finding: The index therapy label warns of increased exposure with strong or moderate CYP1A2 inhibitors.

proposals.goal: flag CYP1A2 inhibition as a potential interaction

symptoms-function.literature: amyotrophic lateral sclerosis swallowing randomized bulbar function

28070747: The short blinded ALS crossover trial found improvement on self-reported swallowing. This supports a symptomatic outcome distinct from disease course.

trial.finding: The protocol calls for objective swallowing measures because patient-reported change alone does not establish safer swallowing.

proposals.goal: improve swallowing function, pending objective confirmation
